deploymentGuard: Run make signalloom-check successfully before creating or applying any Kubernetes pod or workload.

immutableDigest.tagPolicy: Tags are discovery-only; verification, SBOM, provenance, promotion, and rollback evidence bind to the resolved digest.

securityAssurance.evidenceScope: candidate-only; repository-local definition; no production credentials, data, cloud resources, external scans, or release action

releasePack.releaseDecision: fail-closed; no-go until every required gate has a current accepted disposition bound to the candidate digest

revocationRotation.revocation: Withdraw the affected trust anchor or signer identity, reject newly resolved artifacts that depend on it, and preserve the failed verification result with its digest.
revocationRotation.rotation: Use an overlap window with both old and new trust anchors accepted; record successful verification by both, then remove the old anchor and verify rejection.
